decisions.rationale: Android 16 retains permissive mode through product-gated init defaults while preserving the newer SELinux setup and labeling path.

decisions.rationale: All four BlueStacks property files are relabeled and read after Data is mounted. Modern partition defaults remain loaded first so mutable A13 per-instance values retain override precedence; read-only ro.* identity still depends on the complete app-player build.prop packaging path and requires runtime readback.

decisions.performance: Boot-only parsing and restorecon of four small optional files; no polling.
decisions.security: Uses property contexts and explicit restorecon instead of bypassing Android 16 property labeling.
validation_evidence: All four post-data branches and restorecon inputs were reviewed; renewed target compilation and clean-Data file-by-file property readback remain pending.
